message: Looks pretty good big bro, happy to work with you again. Feels like we really accomplished something. Working with my hands like that gives me pause as to what my calling will be. I mean I'm not great at the carpentry work but it was satisfying. Maybe it means that Moses and me rehabbing a house next year will be more fun (with headaches of course) than I previously suspected. Dad fit the engineering carpenter role rather well, good supervision made for an easier project.
